packet.question: Calculate Apple's revenue growth from FY2023 to FY2024 using its FY2024 10-K. Show the two revenues in USD millions and the percentage change rounded to two decimals.

answer.answer:
Apple FY2023 revenue was 383285 million USD.
Apple FY2024 revenue was 391035 million USD.
Apple FY2024 revenue growth was 2.02%.
